result.instructions: Tools for Sonix, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Upload this podcast episode from our public URL and tell me when the transcript is ready."; "Give me the SRT captions for episode 45, with speaker names in uppercase."; "Summarize our last three interviews in 5 sentences each.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Sonix data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run sonix_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sonix_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sonix_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. sonix_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sonix_list_media
tools.title: List media files
tools.description: List media files in the account, newest first, 100 per page. Filter by status, folder or name. Each item has id, name, duration, language, status and created_at. Sonix API: GET /v1/media.

status.description: Filter by status, for example completed, transcribing, aligning or failed.

folder_id.description: Only files in this folder id (from sonix_list_folders).

tools.name: sonix_get_media
tools.title: Get a media file
tools.description: Get one media file: name, duration, language, video flag, status (preparing, transcribing, aligning, completed, blocked, failed, duplicate), folder and public_url. Check status is completed before reading transcripts. Sonix API: GET /v1/media/{id}.

media_id.description: The media id (from sonix_list_media or sonix_upload_media).

tools.name: sonix_list_shares
tools.title: List shares of a media file
tools.description: List the users a media file is shared with, and whether each can edit it. Sonix API: GET /v1/media/{id}/shares.

media_id.description: The media id (from sonix_list_media or sonix_upload_media).

annotations.title: List shares of a media file

tools.name: sonix_get_transcript_text
tools.title: Get transcript text
tools.description: Get the plain-text transcript of a completed media file, with speaker names and timestamps. Pass language to read a translation. Sonix API: GET /v1/media/{id}/transcript.

media_id.description: The media id (from sonix_list_media or sonix_upload_media).

language.description: Translation language code (for example es), from sonix_list_translations. Omit for the original transcript.

tools.name: sonix_get_captions
tools.title: Get captions (SRT or VTT)
tools.description: Get a completed media file as SRT or VTT subtitles. Limit line length with limit_captions, max_characters and max_duration (limit_captions must be true for these). Sonix API: GET /v1/media/{id}/transcript.srt or .vtt.

media_id.description: The media id (from sonix_list_media or sonix_upload_media).

language.description: Translation language code (for example es), from sonix_list_translations. Omit for the original transcript.

speaker_display.description: How speaker names show: none, as_typed, or uppercase (default none).

limit_captions.description: Split subtitles by duration or characters (default false).

tools.name: sonix_get_transcript_json
tools.title: Get transcript as JSON
tools.description: Get a completed transcript as JSON: speakers, and start and end times for each word. Pass language to read a translation. Sonix API: GET /v1/media/{id}/transcript.json.

media_id.description: The media id (from sonix_list_media or sonix_upload_media).

language.description: Translation language code (for example es), from sonix_list_translations. Omit for the original transcript.

tools.name: sonix_list_translations
tools.title: List translations
tools.description: List the languages a media file was translated into, newest request first, with each status. Sonix API: GET /v1/media/{id}/translations.

media_id.description: The media id (from sonix_list_media or sonix_upload_media).

tools.name: sonix_get_translation
tools.title: Get translation status
tools.description: Get the status of one translation (queued, translating, completed or failed). Sonix API: GET /v1/media/{id}/translations/{language}.

media_id.description: The media id (from sonix_list_media or sonix_upload_media).

language.description: Translation language code, for example es.

tools.name: sonix_get_export
tools.title: Get an audio or video export
tools.description: Get the status of a media export (processing or completed) and, when completed, its file_url. Sonix API: GET /v1/media_exports/{id}.

annotations.title: Get an audio or video export

tools.name: sonix_get_burn_in
tools.title: Get a video burn-in status
tools.description: Get the status (processing, completed or failed) and download url of a subtitled video. Sonix API: GET /v1/video_burn_ins/{id}.

burn_in_id.description: The video export id from the burn-in request.

tools.name: sonix_get_summarization
tools.title: Get a summary or answer
tools.description: Get an AI summarization by id: status (processing or completed), subtype, and the summary text. Sonix API: GET /v1/summarizations/{id}.

tools.name: sonix_list_folders
tools.title: List folders
tools.description: List the folders of the account with their access control and restricted users. Use a folder id with sonix_list_media or sonix_upload_media. Sonix API: GET /v1/folders.

tools.name: sonix_list_batch_summarizations
tools.title: List batch summarizations of a folder
tools.description: List the batch summarizations run on a folder, with status and created time. Sonix API: GET /v1/folders/{id}/batch_summarizations.

annotations.title: List batch summarizations of a folder

tools.name: sonix_get_batch_summarization
tools.title: Get a batch summarization
tools.description: Get one batch summarization: status (processing, completed or failed), the prompt, and the summaries. Sonix API: GET /v1/batch_summarizations/{id}.

tools.name: sonix_upload_media
tools.title: Upload media for transcription
tools.description: Start transcription of an audio or video file at a public URL (file_url). Uses transcription minutes of the account. For several spoken languages, set language to multi and list them in language_hints. Sonix API: POST /v1/media.

file_url.description: Public URL of the audio or video file. Sonix downloads it.

language.description: Language code, for example en (default: the account default). Use multi for mixed languages.

language_hints.description: Comma-separated language codes, at least two, required when language is multi.

name.description: Name of the file in Sonix (default: the file name).

folder_id.description: Folder id to place the file in (default: Home).

keywords.description: Comma-separated words to help recognition. Replaces the account keywords for this file.

custom_data.description: Your own key-value tags stored with the file.

tools.name: sonix_update_media
tools.title: Rename or move a media file
tools.description: Change the name, custom label or folder of a media file. Only the given fields change. Sonix API: PUT /v1/media/{id}.

media_id.description: The media id (from sonix_list_media or sonix_upload_media).

custom_label.description: New custom label shown on the file.

folder_id.description: Folder id to move the file to.

annotations.title: Rename or move a media file

tools.name: sonix_create_export
tools.title: Create an audio or video export
tools.description: Export a completed media file as mp3, wav or mp4 (mp4 only for video). Highlights only by default; set remove_strikethrough to drop struck text. Returns an export id; read it with sonix_get_export. Sonix API: POST /v1/media/{id}/media_exports.

media_id.description: The media id (from sonix_list_media or sonix_upload_media).

remove_strikethrough.description: Remove struck-through words from the export (default false).

annotations.title: Create an audio or video export

tools.name: sonix_create_translation
tools.title: Translate a transcript
tools.description: Start a translation of a completed transcript into one language. Track it with sonix_get_translation. Sonix API: POST /v1/media/{id}/translations.

media_id.description: The media id (from sonix_list_media or sonix_upload_media).

language.description: Target language code, for example es or de.

tools.name: sonix_create_summarization
tools.title: Summarize or ask about a transcript
tools.description: Start an AI summary, chapter list, sentiment, topic or entity analysis, or a custom prompt on a completed media file. Subtype custom needs prompt. Track it with sonix_get_summarization. Sonix API: POST /v1/media/{id}/summarizations.

media_id.description: The media id (from sonix_list_media or sonix_upload_media).

prompt.description: Your instruction, for example 'Summarize in 10 sentences'. Required for custom.

sentence_count.description: Number of sentences for a summary.

annotations.title: Summarize or ask about a transcript

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Sonix
prompts.description: What you can do with Sonix here, with example requests to try.
